thesis: FCA meet extent A1&A2 is a bare intersection and is realized exactly by half-space intersection; FCA join extent (A1|A2)'' is a closure of a union, which half-spaces cannot represent, so the geometry must over-approximate and admit phantom objects.

global_config.threshold_rule: tau_m = quantile(E @ v_m, 1-p) so every attribute has density ~= p
notes: MAX_CONCEPTS=5000 exceeds 2**12=4096, the hard ceiling on intents for n_att=12, so the concept cap can never bind in any configuration run here.
Pair sampling is uniform without replacement over the strict upper triangle when C(n_concepts,2) > MAX_PAIRS; otherwise all pairs are used.

Overshoot is reported both over all concept pairs and over incomparable pairs only. Comparable pairs (A1 subset A2) have a union that is already closed, so they contribute a structural zero and would flatter the mean.

gates.context: small: d=32 n_att=7 p=0.5 n_obj=60 seed=0
baseline: d=64 n_att=12 p=0.5 n_obj=200 seed=0

experiment_2_dimension_sweep.note: d < n_att makes linearly independent attribute directions impossible; rank_V is recorded to show exactly where that binds.

experiment_3_coherence_sweep.note: d=64 >> n_att=12, so rank_V stays full throughout: this isolates 'directions happen to be correlated' from 'not enough dimensions'.

mechanism.predictor: mean |B1 & B2| over incomparable concept pairs (number of half-spaces still containing the union)
mechanism.response: mean join overshoot over incomparable pairs
mechanism.caveat: post-hoc descriptive fit on the same runs; not held out.

normalization_dissociation.why: phantoms/|closed| divides by a denominator that itself grows when extents inflate; phantoms/|objects outside the union| holds the number of objects at risk fixed. Where the two disagree in sign, the ratio measure is the misleading one.

max_coherence_alone.note: If max coherence were the sufficient statistic, the dimension arm and the correlation arm would lie on one curve. Compare cells with matched coherence_max_abs across arms in `matched_coherence_cells`.

meet_exactness.claim: meet is realized exactly — zero phantoms, always
